payload.title: Committee management bundles name committee creation as the meeting ID source
payload.actual: Both management bundles name POST /committees as the only meeting_id source. A new committee's detail has no scheduled meetings yet. A later schedule reply and the saved committee detail both identify the meeting; the My committees bundle already names the detail chain correctly.
payload.expected: For committees_ipc and committees_quality, name GET /committees/{committee_id} -> meeting_list[].meeting_id and POST /committees/{committee_id}/meetings -> meeting_id for meeting detail, minutes, finalize, action and PDF paths.
payload.evidence: Synthetic committee 11 only. POST /committees/{committee_id}/meetings 201 request f50abbc0c34a4085b1d1dcf6562db60e, meeting_id 1. GET /committees/{committee_id} 200 request 937389dd7b3f43569fbda8ba3ab0d6c8 returns the same meeting in meeting_list. See matching My committees id_sources. No real data.
